scope: The standing sixteenth-century Ottoman prayer hall, forecourt and fountain, two relief-carved double-balconied minarets, and the adjacent Şehzade Mehmed, Rüstem Paşa and Fatma Sultan mausolea.

originalReview.notes: The same native photograph shows buff ashlar, stone drum ribs, bluish-gray lead, minaret reliefs and Mehmed’s fluted domed tomb behind other low mausolea.

quallaSearch.notes: The contributor’s original self-release is CC0 and byte matches the exact Qualla photo. It shows the qibla elevation and the nearby tombs from Şehzadebaşı Caddesi. Other gallery variants were not needed.
